text: 2026年9月9日，美国Vicor Corporation根据《美国1930年关税法》第337节规定向美国国际贸易委员会提出申请，指控对美出口、在美进口及销售的特定垂直电力传输系统及其组成部分和下游计算机系统（Certain Vertical Power Delivery Systems, Components Thereof, and Computing Systems Containing the Same）侵犯其专利权，请求发起337调查并发布有限排除令和禁止令。中国五家企业涉案。（商务部）
text_en: On September 9, 2026, US-based Vicor Corporation filed an application with the US International Trade Commission under Section 337 of the US Tariff Act of 1930, alleging that certain vertical power delivery systems, components thereof, and computing systems containing the same exported to, imported into, and sold in the US infringe its patent rights, and requesting the initiation of a Section 337 investigation and the issuance of a limited exclusion order and cease and desist order. Five Chinese companies are involved. (Ministry of Commerce)
